approved_note: The owner watches the pilot (E:\SK\kailash-pilot\ep1.mp4) and then sets "approved": true here (the repo variable KAILASH=off pauses it later). Until then scripts/day-plan.mjs plans no kailash slot and nothing is uploaded, like story/movies/<series>/series.json.
rules: STORY.md section 9. Original ideas only: never the reference channel's titles or plots (Parvati roothna/mayke jaana/Kailash chhodna, Mahadev ka krodh se Kailash kaanpna, Nandi ko pushpak vimaan, choohon se jata khulna). story_type: scripture = cite the text in source + description; parampara = a well-known tradition / sthal-katha, said as 'kehte hain' / 'parampara hai' and named in the description; fictional = pure family slice-of-life, the description says 'काल्पनिक प्रस्तुति / भक्तिभाव से बनाई गई कहानी'. No bhang/intoxication, no mocking, no romance beyond dignified divine-couple affection, no violence on screen (a demon story is told in one calm line).

episodes.note: Original script (our own, 15 Nov 2026): the viral 'Parvati ne chhipa diya Bholenath ka Nagdev' topic (12.3 lakh) told as a loving, light moment; never that video's lines or look. No fear or harm to Vasuki; no mocking. Mini (25-40 s) in the cute-3d style.

episodes.moral: Doosron ka dukh samajhna hi bal

episodes.source: Rishi Shilad ke putra Nandi ki tapasya aur Shiv ka sada saath rehne ka vardaan (Shiva Purana, Shatarudra Samhita)
episodes.title: 😱 नंदी जी महादेव के पास कैसे आए? फिर नंदी ने जो बताया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Ganesh Nandi se poochte hain aap hamesha pitaji ke paas kyun
episodes.resolution: Nandi apni tapasya ki kahani sunate hain; Mahadev kehte hain Nandi parivar ka hissa hain
episodes.moral: Sachchi bhakti saath kabhi nahi chhodti

episodes.source: Kartikeya ka paalan chhah Krittikaon ne kiya, isliye Kartikeya / Shanmukha (Shiva Purana, Kumara Khanda; Skanda Purana)
episodes.title: 😱 कार्तिकेय जी की छह माँ? फिर माता पार्वती ने जो कहा… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Ganesh mazaak mein nahi, jigyasa se poochte hain bhaiya ka naam Kartikeya kyun
episodes.resolution: Parvati ji Krittikaon ka aabhaar maanti hain: jo pyaar se paale woh bhi maa
episodes.moral: Paalne wale ka aabhaar kabhi mat bhoolo

episodes.source: Swamimalai sthal-katha: bal Kartikeya (Swaminatha) ne Shiv ko 'Om' ka arth bataya (Tamil parampara)
episodes.title: 😱 बेटे ने पिता को पढ़ाया ओम का अर्थ! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Kartikeya jhijhakte hue kehte hain unhe Om ka ek arth samajh aaya
episodes.resolution: Mahadev shishya ki tarah baith kar sunte hain; Parvati ji kehti hain gyan umar nahi dekhta
episodes.moral: Seekhne mein kabhi sankoch mat karo

episodes.source: Narad ji ka Kamdev par vijay ka garv aur Shiv ji ki salah 'yeh baat Hari se mat kehna' (Ramcharitmanas, Balkand)
episodes.title: 😱 नारद जी अपनी जीत सुनाने आए! फिर महादेव ने जो कहा… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Narad ji khushi se apni tapasya ki safalta sunate hain
episodes.resolution: Mahadev pyaar se samjhaate hain: apni taarif khud na karo; Narad ji 'Narayan Narayan' kehkar muskurate hain
episodes.moral: Vinamrata hi asli jeet

episodes.source: Shiv ka Dakshinamurti roop: maun se upadesh (Dakshinamurti Stotram, Adi Shankaracharya)
episodes.title: 😱 महादेव कुछ नहीं बोले, फिर भी सब समझ गए! फिर जो हुआ… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Ganesh aur Kartikeya bahas karte hain kaun sahi, pitaji se faisla chahte hain
episodes.resolution: Mahadev bas muskurate hain aur dhyan mein baithte hain; dono shaant hokar khud samajh jaate hain
episodes.moral: Kabhi-kabhi maun sabse bada jawab

episodes.source: Bhakt Nandi ke kaan mein manokamna kehte hain (Shiv mandiron ki lok-parampara)
episodes.title: 😱 मूषक जी ने नंदी के कान में क्या कहा? फिर नंदी ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Mushak dekhta hai bhakt Nandi ke kaan mein kuch kehte hain; woh bhi apni ichha bolta hai
episodes.resolution: Nandi Mahadev tak baat pahunchate hain; ichha thi ki Ganesh ji kabhi udaas na hon
episodes.moral: Doosron ke liye maangi dua sabse pehle suni jaati hai

episodes.source: Kuber ke bhoj mein bal Ganesh ki bhookh aur Parvati ji ke diye mutthi bhar chawal se tripti (lok-katha / parampara)
episodes.title: 😱 कुबेर का भोज, फिर भी गणेश जी भूखे! फिर माता ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Kuber apne dhan ka pradarshan karne bhoj dete hain; Ganesh ji ki bhookh nahi mitti
episodes.resolution: Parvati ji prem se mutthi bhar chawal deti hain aur Ganesh tript; Kuber ahankar chhodte hain
episodes.moral: Prem se diya thoda bhi bahut

episodes.title: 😱 पहली बर्फ़ में ठिठुर गए मूषक जी! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Kailash par pehli barf; Ganesh-Kartikeya khelte hain par Mushak thand se kaanpta hai
episodes.resolution: Mahadev apna baagh-ambar Mushak ko odhaate hain; bachche apne shawl baantte hain
episodes.moral: Thand mein ek shawl baantna bhi puja

episodes.title: 😱 बीस लड्डू खाकर मूषक जी बीमार! फिर माता पार्वती ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Mushak Ganesh ji ki tarah laddoo khaane ki hod mein pet pakad leta hai
episodes.resolution: Parvati ji haldi-doodh deti hain aur pyaar se sanyam sikhaati hain; Ganesh bhi muskura kar maante hain
episodes.moral: Achhi cheez bhi sanyam se

episodes.title: 😱 नारद जी बिना बताए कैलाश आ गए! फिर माता पार्वती ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Ghar mein kuch pakaa nahi; Narad ji achanak pahunchte hain, Ganesh-Kartikeya ghabra jaate hain
episodes.resolution: Parvati ji jo hai wahi prem se parosti hain; Narad kehte hain is ghar ka prem hi pakwaan
episodes.moral: Atithi Devo Bhava

episodes.source: Bal Markandeya ki Shiv-bhakti aur Mahadev ki sharan se amar hona (Markandeya Purana; Shiva Purana parampara); Mahamrityunjay
episodes.title: 😱 एक बालक ने शिवलिंग को कसकर पकड़ा! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Ganesh poochte hain Mahamrityunjay mantra kisne gaaya
episodes.resolution: Mahadev bal Markandeya ki bhakti ki katha ek shaant pankti mein sunate hain; bachche saath mein 'Om Namah Shivaya' bolte hain
episodes.moral: Sachche bhakt ki raksha Mahadev karte hain

episodes.source: Halahal ki jalan shaant karne ke liye Shiv par jal chadhane ki parampara (Samudra manthan, Bhagavata Purana 8.7)
episodes.title: 😱 गणेश जी ने पिताजी पर पूरा लोटा उड़ेल दिया! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Ganesh dekhte hain bhakt Shivling par jal chadhate hain, woh bhi pitaji par lota daal dete hain
episodes.resolution: Mahadev hans kar aashirwad dete hain; Parvati ji jal-abhishek ka arth batati hain
episodes.moral: Shraddha ka ek lota bhi kaafi

episodes.source: Solah Somvar vrat katha (lok-parampara); Somvar Shiv ka din
episodes.title: 😱 सोमवार को माता पार्वती ने कुछ नहीं खाया! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Kartikeya chinta karte hain ki maa ne subah se kuch nahi khaya
episodes.resolution: Mahadev sham ko khud prasad laate hain; Parvati ji vrat ka arth batati hain: sanyam aur shraddha
episodes.moral: Vrat sharir ko nahi, mann ko saadhta hai

episodes.title: 😱 कार्तिकेय ने पूछा, हमारा महल क्यों नहीं? फिर महादेव ने जो कहा… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Kartikeya devtaon ke mahal dekh kar lautte hain aur Kailash ki gufa dekhte hain
episodes.resolution: Mahadev bachchon ko taaron bhara aasmaan dikhaate hain: jo hai usmein santosh
episodes.moral: Santosh hi sabse bada dhan

episodes.title: 😱 कार्तिकेय जी का मोर घायल! फिर गणेश जी ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Toofaan mein Kartikeya ke mor ka pankh toot jaata hai, Kartikeya udaas
episodes.resolution: Ganesh apni buddhi se patti baandhte hain, Parvati ji jadi-booti deti hain; bhaiyon ka pyaar
episodes.moral: Mushkil mein bhai hi sahara

episodes.title: 😱 गणेश जी की कलम टूटी, मूषक रो पड़ा! फिर गणेश जी ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Mushak galti se Ganesh ji ki kalam tod deta hai aur darr ke maare rone lagta hai
episodes.resolution: Ganesh ji muskura kar maaf karte hain: galti maan lena hi sabse badi baat
episodes.moral: Maafi maangna aur maaf karna dono bade gun

episodes.title: 😱 बर्फ़ में रास्ता भूले कार्तिकेय! फिर माता पार्वती ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
episodes.premise: Kartikeya andheri barfeeli shaam mein ghar ka raasta bhool jaate hain
episodes.resolution: Parvati ji diya lekar Nandi ke saath dhoondhti hain, ghanti ki awaaz se Kartikeya laut-te hain; maa gale lagati hain
episodes.moral: Maa ki pukaar har andhere mein raasta dikhati hai

ideas.title: 😱 माता पार्वती की रसोई में नमक कम पड़ गया! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
ideas.premise: Parvati ji pehli baar Mahadev ke liye khichdi banati hain; Ganesh ji chakhte hi chehra sikodte hain aur namak kam nikalta hai
ideas.resolution: Mahadev bina kuch kahe poori thaali khaate hain aur kehte hain ki prem ka swad namak se nahi, bhaav se aata hai
ideas.moral: Seva mein bhaav sabse bada masala hai

ideas.title: 😱 गणेश जी घर से दूर चले, माँ रो पड़ीं! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
ideas.premise: Ganesh ji pehli baar Kailash se door Vyas ji ke saath likhne jaane lagte hain; Parvati ji ki aankhon mein aansu aate hain aur woh chup ho jaati hain
ideas.resolution: Mahadev Parvati ji ko samjhaate hain ki bachche ki pehli udaan maa ke aashirwad se hoti hai; Ganesh ji laut kar maa ke charan chhute hain aur kehte hain ki unki shiksha hamesha saath rahegi
ideas.moral: Vida ka dukh, aashirwad se halka hota hai

ideas.title: 😱 गणेश जी ने मोदक की थाली छिपा दी! फिर माता पार्वती ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
ideas.premise: Kaalpanik prastuti: Parvati ji ne Ganesh ji ke liye modak ki thaali rakhi; thodi der mein thaali khaali, aur Ganesh ji ke haath mein chasni
ideas.resolution: Mahadev muskurate hue ek modak Ganesh ji ke haath mein rakhte hain aur kehte hain ki bhog maatra se nahi, bhaav se hota hai
ideas.moral: Bhaav ka bhog sabse pyara hai

ideas.title: 😱 पूजा की थाली से अक्षत गायब! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
ideas.premise: Parvati ji puja ki thaali saja rahi hain; akshat ki katori khaali milti hai, Bal Ganesh ke gaal par chawal ke daane chipke hain, aur Mooshak ji paas hi chup baithe hain
ideas.resolution: Bal Ganesh bhaav se bataate hain ki daane unhone Mooshak ji ke liye bachaaye the; Mahadev kehte hain ki arpan ka bhaav hi akshat hai, aur sab milkar bhog lagate hain
ideas.moral: Arpan mein bhaav sabse bada akshat hai

ideas.title: 😱 महादेव के कमंडल का जल रोज़ कम क्यों? फिर माता पार्वती ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
ideas.premise: Kartikeya ji dekhte hain ki Mahadev ke kamandal ka jal roz subah kuch kam ho jaata hai, aur sochte hain ki koi chori kar raha hai
ideas.resolution: Parvati ji chupke se dekhti hain: Mahadev bina bataye kamandal ka jal raaste ke pyaase jeev-jantuon ko pila rahe hain; Kartikeya ko seekh milti hai ki seva ko dikhana zaroori nahi
ideas.moral: Chhupi seva sabse uchchi seva hai

ideas.title: 😱 माता पार्वती का झूला टूटा! फिर गणेश जी ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
ideas.premise: Kailash par Parvati ji ka jhoola ek jhatke mein toot jaata hai; Bal Ganesh doudkar rassi dhoondhte hain aur Mahadev ko bulaate hain, par Parvati ji ghabra jaati hain
ideas.resolution: Mahadev apni jata ke ek dhaage se jhoole ko naye sire se baandhte hain aur kehte hain: jo saath jhoolta hai, woh kabhi nahi girta
ideas.moral: Saath pakadna hi sabse majboot jhoola

ideas.title: 😱 माता पार्वती का दर्पण गायब! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
ideas.premise: Parvati ji Somvar ke vrat ke liye shringar karne baithti hain aur darpan nahi milta; Ganesh ji poora kaksh ulat dete hain, Mahadev shaant baithe hain
ideas.resolution: Ganesh ji maafi maangte hain; Mahadev kehte hain ki darpan mein sirf chehra dikhta hai, bhaav nahi, aur Parvati ji dono bachchon ko gale lagaati hain
ideas.moral: Shringar bhaav se hota hai, shisha se nahi

ideas.title: 😱 माता पार्वती की मेहंदी का रंग फीका! फिर महादेव ने जो किया… 🔱❤️ | Mahadev Parvati
ideas.premise: Hariyali Teej ki subah Parvati ji ki mehndi halki aati hai; bal Ganesh ji rang gaadhne ki tarkeeb sujhate hain aur sab ulajhte hain
ideas.resolution: Mahadev aate hain, Parvati ji ki hatheli thaam kar kehte hain ki rang mehndi mein nahi, lagane wale ke bhaav mein hota hai; teeno mil kar mehndi sajate hain
ideas.moral: Rang haath se nahi, bhaav se chadhta hai
